messages:
maria: CI turned red on quant-smoke (a100 MIG partitioned). Seeing OOMs on shard-2 and shard-3 after the allocator tweak merged last night. Can someone take a look?

devin: which job? link? any stderr/pod logs?

maria: job link: https://ci.redwood/integrations/quant-smoke/3456
maria: gist with condensed logs: https://gist.github.com/maria/abcd1234

maria: small log snippet:
```
[2026-01-29T07:41:02Z] [worker-3] RuntimeError: CUDA_ERROR_LAUNCH_OUT_OF_RESOURCES
  at /opt/workspace/runtime/launcher.cu:123
  kernel: quant::atten_forward, grid=(1024,1,1), block=(256,1,1)
  NVML free mem low: 150MB
```

charlie: odd — allocator change was supposed to reduce fragmentation. Maybe MIG partitioning + batch-size spike interacts badly. Any pattern on sequence length or batch?

maria: failures correlate with long-seq tests (seq=8192) and pinned batch=4. Local repro with `--seq 8192 --batch 4` on single-mig slice reproduces fast.

devin: try rerun with the older allocator image? tag: `runtime:release-2026-01-27` to confirm revert hypothesis.

maria: good idea. @ci-bot can we queue a rerun with that image on the same node pool?

ci-bot: Rerun queued: quant-smoke #3456 (repro-image=runtime:release-2026-01-27, mig=true) — build 3456.2. Assigned to eng-ml. ETA ~ 12m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sre-oncall: FYI we also saw a transient driver patch on that pool last night. I pinned drivers on pool-ml-3 at 525.85. If the rerun hits different nodes, add `nodeSelector: pool-ml-3` to be consistent.

charlie: if rerun is green, we can bisect the allocator change by reverting the single commit that touched the arena alignment. If still red, we'll look at kernel launch params and NV driver interaction.

ci-bot: Rerun finished: quant-smoke #3456.2 — status: failed (OOM on worker-3). Full logs: https://ci.redwood/integrations/quant-smoke/3456/logs/3456.2

maria: confirmed failed on same shard-3. attaching `nvidia-smi topo -m` and `nvidia-smi -q` from node:
```
GPU 0: MIG slice 1/3
FB Memory Usage: Total 40GB, Used 39.7GB
Processes: python (pid 7123) consuming 38.9GB
Driver Version: 525.85
```

devin: ok driver matches pinned one. Next step: can you run the job with `--allocator=legacy` locally to see if it avoids OOM? If yes, we have a bisect path.

maria: starting local run with `--allocator=legacy` now, will post result in ~10m.

sre-oncall: leaving a note: if we end up bisecting, please run each candidate on pool-ml-3 with `nodeSelector` to keep node-level variables consistent.

ci-bot: maria posted: local run with `--allocator=legacy` — result: PASS (no OOM, completes in 12m).

charlie: that's a pretty clear signal. Please open a bisect PR reverting allocator commit (or run `git bisect` over the allocator changes) and tag me + @devin. I'll prioritize the review.

maria: filing PR and starting bisect: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/789 (WIP) — will comment with candidate commits.

devin: thanks. If bisect narrows to alignment change, we can try a mitigation (alignment fallback for MIG slices) before full revert.

maria: noted. I'll keep updates in this thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
